challenge.notes:
All records come from a model transcription of Figure 4. Gene assignment is still supported by author text: the caption maps panel A to COL4A1 (NM_001845.6) and panel B to COL4A2 (NM_001846.4), and the transcription shows panels labeled A and B.

Inheritance is recorded as unknown throughout, but the text describes some inherited cases that cannot be mapped to specific variants:
- A late-childhood COL4A1 sibling pair with sensorineural hearing loss inherited a VUS from their father.
- Two asymptomatic patients were tested because of a symptomatic parent.

challenge.notes: No records were extracted. This is a candidate-gene screen of COL4A1 and COL4A2 in Ecuadorian keratoconus families: 48 individuals from 15 families, plus 64 controls. Family KTCN-014 contributed 23 members; 25 affected individuals came from 14 other families. The authors conclude that no causative mutations were found, and that all coding variants are benign or common polymorphisms. They note that Gln1334His (c.4002A>C, rs3742207) in COL4A1 was predicted possibly damaging by PolyPhen but was not significantly associated with disease (p=0.056 within the family; p=0.17 in cases vs controls). The listed missed variants are the coding, UTR, and selected intronic designations printed in the text and Table 2. Table 2 contains many more intronic variants written with en-dash notation; these are also unrecorded. None of these variants is reported as pathogenic.

challenge.notes: No records were extracted. The paper studies one mouse Col4a1 allele, Svc (Col4a1+/Svc): a G-to-A transition producing a G1064D substitution in the α1(IV) chain. This is a mouse model study with no human probands or families. Phenotypes in heterozygous mice are a discontinuous tendon basement membrane, reduced laminin and spontaneous flexor tendon adhesions. The paper also cites vacuolar cataracts, small body size, bruising at birth and arteriolar silvering, attributed to earlier work. The text gives no COL4A2 variant.

Panel B shows only 8 COL4A2 variants, but the text reports 9 distinct COL4A2 variants plus 2 patients without reports, so one COL4A2 variant may not have been transcribed. The variant carried by the patient with variants in both genes is not identified.
